UPDATE copilot_drafts
                SET status = $1, model = $2, stop_reason = $3, body = $4,
                    token_usage = $5, last_error = $6, grounding = $7,
                    grounded_event_ids = $8, lease_expires_at = NULL,
                    completed_at = $9, updated_at = $9
              WHERE draft_id = $10
